siteMeta.description: Follow Bryn Jones on his 2,050 km charity walk from Buckinghamshire in Buckinghamshire to St. Peter's Square in Rome along the historic Via Francigena.

openGraph.title: Bryn Jones | Walking from Buckinghamshire to Rome
openGraph.description: 2,050 kilometres on foot through the UK, France, Switzerland, and Italy in support of life-changing charities.

paragraphs: Hello, I am Bryn Jones. In the summer of 2028 I will be beginning a long journey from my home in Buckinghamshire to Rome in support of 2 charities. This website will allow you to follow along on my trip.

My walk will take me through 8 countries via historic trails and over the alps. It's over 1500 miles and will take roughly 4 months. It will be a massive test of physical ability and endurance and I will be pushed to my limits.

During my walk I will be uploading daily video diaries to social media as an update to everyone. However until then, you can join my weekly email newsletter where I will be updating you on my training, route planning, and gear acquisition. You can always follow my Instagram, @home2rome2028, where I will regularly be posting about my training.
